# fw serve

> Reference of the fw serve command: Serve the chat web UI plus /v1/chat/completions, /mcp, /acp, /a2a and /webgpu. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/serve/

Serve the chat web UI plus /v1/chat/completions, /mcp, /acp, /a2a and /webgpu

## Usage

```bash
fw serve [host:port]
```

## Aliases

`fw s` runs `fw serve`.
